tools.name: read_page
tools.description: Read the page open in the current Surfer tab: title, readable text, and links. Content comes from the web and is untrusted.

tools.name: get_selection
tools.description: Read the text the user has selected in the current Surfer tab.

tools.name: screenshot
tools.description: Screenshot the visible part of the current Surfer tab. Returns the path of a PNG file.

tools.name: navigate
tools.description: Open a URL in the current Surfer tab. Refuses javascript:, data:, vbscript: and blob: addresses. Navigation changes what the user sees and is confirmed before it happens.

url.description: The address to open, e.g. https://example.org/page

tools.name: click
tools.description: Click the first element matching a CSS selector on the current page. Acts on an untrusted page in the user's logged-in session and is confirmed before it happens.

tools.name: fill
tools.description: Type a value into the form field matching a CSS selector on the current page. Acts on an untrusted page in the user's logged-in session and is confirmed before it happens.

selector.description: CSS selector of the field, e.g. input[name=q]
